name: Owll
description:
Owll is an AI note-taking product for meetings, recordings, documents, images, and other content. Owll for Claude connects to a user's authorized Owll library, allowing
 them to search notes, browse folders, view note details and AI-generated summaries, and access or export transcripts upon request. The current version provides read-only  access and cannot create, edit, or delete notes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Owll to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Owll to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.owll.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Owll MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Owll provides these MCP tools: count_owll_notes, export_owll_note_transcript_file, export_owll_notes_transcript_files_batch, get_owll_note_metadata, get_owll_note_summary, get_owll_note_transcript, get_owll_notes_summary_batch, get_owll_notes_transcript_batch, list_owll_folders, list_owll_notes, search_owll_notes, and submit_owll_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Owll?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Owll in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Owll requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Owll is developed by Owll.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
